title: Designing Reliable Business Workflows — practice

objective: Apply designing reliable business workflows and verify its result safely.

options: Assume the reference output guarantees behavior across all MongoDB versions and deployment types.

expected_output: Identify the invariant across writes, compare a conditional single-document update with a transaction, and test abort/retry behavior on a supported test deployment.
